Rubber Band Library 4.0.0 (bundled source)
========================================

This repository includes the full upstream Rubber Band Library 4.0.0 source
at third_party/rubberband-4.0.0/.

The Android native build uses:
  third_party/rubberband-4.0.0/single/RubberBandSingle.cpp
and the other source files included by that compilation unit.

The setup scripts SETUP_RUBBERBAND.bat and SETUP_RUBBERBAND.ps1 are retained
for recovery if the vendor source directory is missing. They are not
necessary when cloning the complete repository containing the source.

Rubber Band is Copyright 2007-2024 Particular Programs Ltd (Breakfast Quay)
and is redistributed under GPL-2.0-or-later (commercial license alternative
available from the copyright holder).

Upstream: https://breakfastquay.com/rubberband/
Source:   https://github.com/breakfastquay/rubberband
License:  third_party/rubberband-4.0.0/COPYING
Notices:  THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md (repository root)

Do not remove upstream copyright notices, the COPYING file, or the source
files required to build the native library.
